title: Замок и осадный шар: дыры, падения и бочки
scope: Castle horse plus the siege airship: animated E banners, occupancy flight (anyone inside presses Space; E puts you there), detailed optimized basket, powder barrels thrown a metre forward to fall physically and explode with the C4, holes/crash/fall damage/map clamp, weight steering, no cap, no anchor/Shift.
